title: Student Finance, Actually Explained
description: A practical first-week workshop on reading your student finance statement, budgeting a loan that arrives in three termly instalments rather than monthly, how a student overdraft actually works, and council tax exemption. Open floor for questions specific to your situation. No prior knowledge needed.

title: FLaT Quiz Night
description: Finance, law and tech trivia in teams of 4–6, prizes for the winning team. A relaxed way to meet other members after the term's first session.
